title: Fluorescence excitation-scanning hyperspectral imaging with scalable 2D-3D deep learning framework for colorectal cancer detection.
summary: The primary study applies deep learning to colorectal-cancer hyperspectral images and reports an independent new-patient test with high classification performance. This is a specific diagnostic-validation result on a small research dataset, not a deployed screening system.
ai_technology: A scalable two-dimensional/three-dimensional deep-learning framework classified colorectal cancer from fluorescence hyperspectral images.
